observations.epoch_band_state_and_other_notes: Detected LPT with M4.5V donor (M4.0V not excluded) and WD strongly favored by blue excess/two-component spectrum; no direct WD lines or field measurement. deRuiter+25 report seven 30–90 s LOFAR pulses at 120–168 MHz, peak 41–256 mJy/beam, 2% duty cycle, detections in 7/26 periods, 1-s brightest peak 431 mJy/beam, spectral index −4.1±1.1, DM=16±6 pc cm−3, linear polarization 51±6%, circular-polarization limits <1.6% and <4.2%. Published 125.52978±0.00002 min converts to 7531.7868±0.0012 s topocentric; Rodriguez+26 cites a distinct barycentric 7531.1699±0.0012 s from private communication. RV orbit is 7530±390 s, too imprecise to establish sub-second equality or WD spin. Distances remain competing: Rodriguez+26 SED 300±30 pc; deRuiter+25 SED 333±25 pc; Gaia geometric posterior 504 pc [395,652] (photogeometric 710 pc [615,845]). Main display retains Rodriguez SED fit for compatibility but alternatives are unresolved. Swift XRT/UVOT are upper limits only and model/band dependent.

issues.competing_evidence: Rodriguez+26 optical spectrum fit: 300±30 pc; deRuiter+25 broadband SED: 333±25 pc (337±25 with Gaia prior); Gaia EDR3 geometric 504 pc [395,652], photogeometric 710 pc [615,845].
issues.why_it_matters: Distance changes luminosities, absolute magnitude and inferred radii; SED results lie below geometric parallax posterior.
issues.needed_action: Choose display-distance convention or show Gaia posterior plus both SED fits; do not average.

issues.competing_evidence: Published 125.52978±0.00002 min converts to 7531.7868±0.0012 s topocentric; Rodriguez cites a distinct 7531.1699±0.0012 s barycentric value from private communication; RV orbit 7530±390 s.
issues.why_it_matters: Clock identity and synchronization affect polar/asynchronous interpretation.
issues.needed_action: Verify/reprocess barycentric timing and obtain multi-night RV ephemeris; keep all periods separate meanwhile.

issues.competing_evidence: M4.5V donor is spectroscopic; blue excess and DA+M fit favor a WD, but no direct WD Balmer/Zeeman/cyclotron signature or field measurement.
issues.why_it_matters: Whether WD LPT classification is confirmed affects population counts; magnetic CV/WD-pulsar connection is not established.
issues.needed_action: Retain “WD favored by SED; magnetic/polar status unconfirmed” unless direct WD evidence is judged sufficient.

issues.competing_evidence: deRuiter+25 places pulses at donor superior conjunction; Rodriguez+26 finds phase 0.33–0.35, about 0.1 cycle after RV maximum, conditional on radio=orbital period.
issues.why_it_matters: Phase relation constrains orbital gating versus independent spin clock and emission geometry.
issues.needed_action: Resolve with phase-connected radio ephemeris and consecutive-night spectroscopy; retain both published results meanwhile.

issues.competing_evidence: M4.5V is best but M4V not excluded. Rodriguez fixed log g=8 WD model, 10-Gyr solar Baraffe donor, 10% donor inflation and E(B−V)=0.01; Table 1 prints E(B−V)=0.01±0.001.
issues.why_it_matters: Assumptions affect component parameters and comparison; extinction notation differs within paper.
issues.needed_action: Keep outputs model-labeled; decide whether to record extinction as fixed or with table uncertainty.
